title: New Mexico Statutes Annotated 1978, Chapter 27 (Public Assistance), Article 2 - Public Assistance Act
verified_how: Fetched the NM OneSource chapter page (item 4358, '?iframe=true' form) in a browser on 23 September 2026: page title 'Chapter 27 - Public Assistance - NMOneSource.com', collection 'Current New Mexico Statutes Annotated 1978', date 2026; the table of contents lists 'ARTICLE 2 Public Assistance Act' with no repeal marker, in a chapter where repealed articles are marked (e.g. 'ARTICLE 12 Child Health (Repealed.)').
notes: The Public Assistance Act is the framework statute for state-administered assistance and Medicaid. The closely related Article 2B is the New Mexico Works Act (the TANF programme), and Article 6 covers utility supplements and assistance; both remain in force and are cross-references rather than competing choices for this topic.
